tools.name: tailscale_list_devices
tools.description: List all devices in the tailnet (name, addresses, OS, last seen, tags, etc.). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/devices.

tools.name: tailscale_get_device
tools.description: Get a single device by id. Tailscale REST: GET /device/{deviceId}.

tools.name: tailscale_list_device_routes
tools.description: List the subnet routes a device advertises and which are enabled. Tailscale REST: GET /device/{deviceId}/routes.

tools.name: tailscale_list_keys
tools.description: List auth keys and API access tokens for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys.

tools.name: tailscale_get_key
tools.description: Get details of a single auth key / API access token by id (capabilities, expiry, usage). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys/{keyId}.

tools.name: tailscale_get_policy_file
tools.description: Get the tailnet's ACL / policy file (returned as JSON via the Accept header, not HuJSON). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/acl.

tools.name: tailscale_list_dns_nameservers
tools.description: List the global DNS nameservers configured for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/nameservers.

tools.name: tailscale_get_dns_preferences
tools.description: Get the tailnet's DNS preferences (e.g. whether MagicDNS is enabled). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/preferences.

tools.name: tailscale_list_dns_searchpaths
tools.description: List the DNS search paths (search domains) configured for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/searchpaths.

tools.name: tailscale_get_split_dns
tools.description: Get the tailnet's split-DNS configuration — a map of domain → nameservers. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/split-dns.

tools.name: tailscale_list_users
tools.description: List users of the tailnet, optionally filtered by type, role or status. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/users.

tools.name: tailscale_get_user
tools.description: Get a single user by id. Tailscale REST: GET /users/{userId}.

tools.name: tailscale_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints configured for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/webhooks.

tools.name: tailscale_get_tailnet_settings
tools.description: Get the tailnet's settings (device approval, key expiry, posture, etc.). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/settings.

tools.name: tailscale_authorize_device
tools.description: Authorize or de-authorize a device (only relevant when device approval is enabled for the tailnet). Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/authorized.

tools.name: tailscale_set_device_name
tools.description: Set (rename) a device's name. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/name.

tools.name: tailscale_set_device_tags
tools.description: Set a device's ACL tags. REPLACES the device's existing tags. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/tags.

tools.name: tailscale_expire_device_key
tools.description: Expire a device's node key, forcing it to re-authenticate — a security response to a compromised or lost device. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/expire.

tools.name: tailscale_set_device_routes
tools.description: Set the subnet routes ENABLED for a device (from the routes it advertises). REPLACES the enabled set. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/routes.

tools.name: tailscale_create_auth_key
tools.description: Create a new auth key for the tailnet (used to register new devices). Tailscale REST: POST /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys.

tools.name: tailscale_delete_key
tools.description: Delete (revoke) an auth key or API access token by id — a security response. Tailscale REST: DELETE /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys/{keyId}.

tools.name: tailscale_delete_device
tools.description: Delete a device, removing it from the tailnet. Tailscale REST: DELETE /device/{deviceId}.
